ruleSavedApplied_one: Rule saved and applied to {count} transaction
ruleSavedApplied_other: Rule saved and applied to {count} transactions
ruleAppliesToAll: The rule applies to every transaction of the database whose label contains the keyword, categorized ones included (except the categories chosen by hand), then to each new transaction.
ruleAppliesToUncategorized: The rule applies to the transactions of the database whose label contains the keyword, uncategorized or categorized by a rule, then to each new transaction: the other categories do not change.
ruleCount_one: {count} transaction contains this keyword, {categorized} of them in this category
ruleCount_other: {count} transactions contain this keyword, {categorized} of them in this category
transactionCountedOnHelp: The month it counts in (totals, budgets). The real date of the bank does not change, the synchronization keeps this choice.
transactionCommentPlaceholder: E.g. paid back by Paul in June
transactionCommentHelp: Free text seen by the whole household. The synchronization does not change it.
confirmDeleteTransaction: Delete the transaction "{label}"? It will not be imported again by the synchronization nor by the import of a file.
weakJwtSecret: The key protecting the sessions is the example one: renew it (everybody will have to log in again, portal and iOS app).
confirmRotateJwtSecret: Renew the key of the sessions? Every user, you included, will have to log in again.
bankSetupHelp: Your credentials are given to woob, which keeps them on your server to connect to your bank. Carbure does not store them.
bankConnectionLabelHelp: Optional: a name to recognize this access (e.g. "Joint account" or "BNP pro"), can be changed later.
confirmDeleteBankConnection: Remove the connection {bank}? woob forgets its credentials and its followed accounts will no longer be followed (followed accounts: {count}). The transactions already imported are kept.
woobTrustHelp: woob downloads the bank modules (the code that reads your bank credentials) from its repository and checks their signature with the key of this repository. This key is not trusted yet: trust it once, woob will check the next keys with the previous one.
woobTrustCompare: Compare this fingerprint with the one published or announced by the woob maintainers before trusting it. woob will only be accepted if it shows exactly this fingerprint.
woobNotTrusted: woob repository not trusted: compare its fingerprint before trusting it.
bankConnected: Bank connected: choose the accounts to follow
bankConnectedNoAccount: Bank configured, but no account found: check your credentials
bankConnected2fa: Bank connected: approve the strong authentication asked by your bank
footerLicense: Free software under the MIT license
flowHelp: Where the money of the month comes from and where it goes: expenses by category, savings and what is left. Internal transfers (off-budget) are left out.
importDrop: Drop the file of your bank here
importDropHint: or click to choose it (1 MB at most)
importHelp: Download the statement from the online banking of your bank, as OFX, QIF, CSV or CAMT.053. Before the import, Carbure shows the transactions already there and the probable duplicates. The categorization rules apply to the imported transactions.
importTooLarge: The file is larger than {size} KB.
importDuplicateHelp: A probable duplicate has the same amount as an existing transaction a few days apart (often the same one, synchronized with another label). They are not checked: check them to import them anyway.
flowClickHint: Click a category to see its transactions.
accountLocked: Account locked for 24 hours after 5 failed logins. An administrator can unlock it.
tooManyLogins: Too many login attempts from this address: try again in a minute.
mcpOnHelp: AI agents can connect with an access token.
mcpOffHelp: An administrator must enable the MCP server to connect an AI agent.
mcpOffHelpAdmin: Enable the MCP server to let the users connect an AI agent.
agentHow_claudeCode: In a terminal, run this command, then /mcp in Claude Code to check the connection.
oauthConnectHelp: In Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Paste this URL, then click Connect: Claude brings you back here to allow the access. No token to create; Carbure must be reachable over HTTPS from Internet.
oauthIntro: {name} asks to read the data of the household (transactions, budgets, categories, trends), read-only, to answer your questions.
oauthRedirect: You will then go back to {host}.
oauthRevoke: You can remove this access at any time: it is listed in "My access tokens" of the AI agent tab.
agentHow_chatgpt: Settings → Apps & Connectors → Developer mode → Create: paste this URL (Carbure must be reachable over HTTPS from Internet), without authentication.
agentHow_cursor: Settings → MCP → Add a server: paste this block in ~/.cursor/mcp.json.
agentHow_vscode: Command "MCP: Open User Configuration": paste this block in mcp.json, then use Copilot in Agent mode.
agentHow_gemini: In a terminal, run this command, then /mcp in Gemini CLI to check the connection.
insightValid: Valid query: {amount} for the displayed month
schemaUpdateAvailable_one: A database update is available ({count} step). Back up your database, then apply it.
schemaUpdateAvailable_other: A database update is available ({count} steps). Back up your database, then apply it.
confirmMigrate: Is your database backed up? The update keeps your data.
setupSubtitle: A few details and Carbure is ready.
setupDatabaseHelp: Carbure stores your data in a MariaDB or MySQL database. With Docker, everything is already filled in: just click Continue.
setupCodeHelp: Carbure is reached from Internet: type the code shown in the logs of the Docker container (or in the conf/setup.code file of the server).
setupDbPasswordDockerHelp: Leave empty: the password of docker-compose.yml is used.
setupState_none: Empty database: Carbure will create its tables.
setupState_current: Existing Carbure database, up to date: your data is kept.
setupState_outdated: Existing Carbure database: updates have to be applied. Your data is kept.
setupBackupConfirm: I have a backup of my database
setupStarterHelp: Optional: you can change or delete everything later.
setupStarterCategories: Add common categories and categorization rules
setupBackupRequired: Confirm that your database is saved before updating it.
setupAdminHelp: This account manages Carbure: bank accounts, categories, users of the household.
setupPasswordTooShort: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
setupDoneHelp: Log in, then add your bank accounts in the Accounts tab.
insightMoveHelp: Drag the handle on the grid, or use the arrow keys (Home, End) to move the card.
insightHidden: Insight {name} hidden: the + button offers it again
insightCatalogHelp: Hidden insights are not computed. Show the ones you find useful: the choice applies to the whole household.
insightCatalogEmpty: All the insights are already shown.
insightAlertHelp: Get a notification when the value of the month (without its sign, as on the card) goes above or below an amount. At most one alert per month; choose the channels in My profile → Notifications.
insightAlertDirection: Alert me when the value goes
insightSqlHelp: A single SELECT query returning an amount column; {month} and {year} are replaced by the displayed month. It is tested when saved and run read-only (users, api_tokens and devices tables forbidden).
apiTokensHelp: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot or Gemini to Carbure: they can read your data, read-only, to answer your questions about your budget.
apiTokenNameHelp: To recognize it, e.g. "Claude Code on my laptop".
apiTokenShownOnce: Copy this token now: it will never be shown again.
apiTokenPrivacy: The data read by an AI agent (labels, amounts, categories) is sent to its provider for the analysis. Revoke a token at any time to cut the access.
confirmRevokeApiToken: Revoke the token "{name}"? Claude will no longer access your data with it.
ruleKeywordHelp: Keyword searched in the label of the transactions (remove dates and card numbers).
ruleAmountHelp: Only the transactions of this amount (absolute value, expense or income) get the category; it wins over a rule with the same keyword and no amount. Empty: any amount.
categoriesHelp: Categories classify the transactions and carry the budgets. Icons and colors are shared with the iOS app.
accountsHelp: Bank accounts synchronized with woob, with the result of their last synchronization.
roleHelp: An administrator also manages the rules, categories, accounts and users.
confirmDeleteCategory: Delete the category "{name}"? Its transactions become uncategorized, its budgets and rules are deleted.
noFollowedAccountInBank: No followed account: add accounts of this bank.
otherAccountsHelp: Accounts of a bank no longer connected, or imported from a file.
noConnectedBank: No connected bank: the "+" button connects one, then add its accounts.
bankSetupLoading: Loading the information asked by the bank…
connectBankHelp: Choose your bank and type your credentials: woob connects to it, then you choose the accounts to follow. A bank already connected can be connected again with other credentials.
woobWarning: The synchronization goes through woob, a third-party software whose open source connectors read the data of the banks. As the websites of the banks change all the time, these connectors depend on the woob community: a fix sometimes stays several weeks in the woob repository before being merged into its main branch. In case of a synchronization error, check on the GitLab of woob whether a contributor proposed a fix, or wait for it to be merged: you will get it automatically with the update of the woob modules (at each start of Carbure, or with “Update the bank modules” in Accounts).
woobWarningLink: See the fixes proposed on the GitLab of woob
connectBankChoose: Choose a bank supported by woob…
addAccountsHelp: Accounts woob finds with this connection: tick the ones to follow.
discoverNoAccount: woob finds no account for this bank.
discover2faWaiting: Your bank asks for a strong authentication: approve the connection in its app, without closing this window. The accounts are shown next.
accountLabelHelp: Optional: shown instead of the bank and the end of the number.
confirmDeleteAccount: Stop following the account {account}? Its imported transactions are kept.
syncStatus_running: Synchronizing, this can take a few minutes…
syncStatus_busy: A synchronization is already running, try again in a few minutes
woobIssues: Known issue? See the woob tickets about the "{module}" module
sync2faHelp: The bank asks for a strong authentication: start it, then approve the connection on your phone (bank app). It stays valid for several weeks.
sync2faWaiting: Strong authentication: approve the connection in your bank app if asked, the synchronization waits for your approval.
syncWoobUpdateHelp: A bank error often comes from an outdated woob module: update the bank modules, then run the synchronization again.
rulesHelp: A transaction whose label contains the keyword gets the chosen category.
applyRulesHelp: Apply every rule to every transaction of the database, except the categories chosen by hand
rulesApplied_one: Rules applied to the whole database: {count} transaction recategorized
rulesApplied_other: Rules applied to the whole database: {count} transactions recategorized
applyRulesHelpUncategorized: Apply every rule to the transactions of the database that are uncategorized or categorized by a rule
rulesAppliedUncategorized_one: Rules applied to the uncategorized transactions: {count} transaction categorized
rulesAppliedUncategorized_other: Rules applied to the uncategorized transactions: {count} transactions categorized
rulesKeepCategorizedOnHelp: A new, modified or resynchronized rule only categorizes the transactions that are uncategorized or categorized by a rule: the other categories are never overwritten.
rulesKeepCategorizedOffHelp: A new, modified or resynchronized rule also recategorizes the categorized transactions whose label contains its keyword, except the categories chosen by hand.
rulesKeepCategorizedOn: The rules now keep the existing categories
rulesKeepCategorizedOff: The rules now recategorize every transaction
trendsRangeInvalid: Invalid period: the first month must come before the last one, the current month at the latest, over {months} months at most
trendCategoriesEmpty: No transaction of this type in the period
trendCategoriesNoneShown: No category selected: click a category or “All” to show it.
trendsSavingsHelp: Amounts moved to the "Épargne" (savings) category and its sub-categories, minus withdrawals.
noRecurringReceived: No recurring transaction received this month
recurringCalendarHelp: Calendar of the recurring transactions of the month
splitHelp: Split the amount across several categories
splitHintAllocate: Allocate the whole amount of the transaction to save.
splitHintIncomplete: Choose a category and an amount for each line.
splitExceeded: The lines exceed the amount of the transaction by {amount}.
manualSyncedHelp: Synchronized account: if the bank later sends the same transaction, delete the duplicate.
manualAccountsHelp: Accounts never synchronized, whose transactions are entered by hand: cash, a bank woob does not support.
manualAccountNumberHelp: For example its IBAN without spaces; an identifier is created if empty.
tagsHelp: Follow the cost of a project (trip, works…) without changing the categories: each transaction keeps its own. A tag is offered during its period, then archived.
tagsEmptyHelp: Create one with the + button to follow the cost of a trip, of works…
tagChartExplore: Running cost chart: left and right arrows to go through the days
tagChartLabel: Running cost of #{name} day by day
tagNoTransaction: No transaction has this tag yet.
tagNameHelp: Letters, digits, - or _ (40 at most), without the #.
tagEndHelp: After this date, the tag is archived.
tagSelectHelp: Select transactions to add them a tag, change their category or delete them
tagAddToSelection: Add a tag to the selection
selectionCategoryHelp_one: Changes the category of the selected transaction
selectionCategoryHelp_other: Changes the category of the {count} selected transactions
confirmDeleteSelection_one: Delete the selected transaction? It will not be imported again by the synchronization or a file import.
confirmDeleteSelection_other: Delete the {count} selected transactions? They will not be imported again by the synchronization or a file import.
tagNoneActive: No active tag: type a name above to create it, or {link}.
tagNoneActiveLink: create one in the Tags tab
confirmDeleteTag: Delete the tag #{name}? Its transactions are kept.
searchPlaceholder: Search a label or a comment…
advancedSearchAmountHelp: Without sign: 50 finds an expense of 50 as well as an income of 50.
noBudgetMessage: No budget defined for this period
budgetChildrenHelp: Without a set amount, the budget of the category is the sum of the budgets of its sub-categories.
budgetSumOfChildren: Sum of the budgets of the sub-categories
budgetCopyHelp: Copies the budgets of {month} to the displayed month.
budgetCopyMissing: Fill in only (keep the amounts already set)
budgetCopyOverwrite: Overwrite the budgets of the displayed month
apiDocsHelp: The routes of the Carbure REST API, described by Swagger UI. “Try it out” calls the API with your session: the requests really change the data.
apiDocsBlocked: Swagger UI cannot be shown here: the HTTP server (often the reverse proxy in front of Carbure) forbids showing it in a frame (header X-Frame-Options: DENY or frame-ancestors 'none'). Open it in a new tab, or let the headers of the container through for /swagger/ (X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, frame-ancestors 'self').
configIntro: Content of {file}. Only the safe settings are changed here, each value being checked by the server; the previous file is kept as .bak. The secrets (except the SMTP password, replaced without ever being shown), the database, the woob command and the cleaning of the labels are changed on the server.
configNotWritable: The web server cannot write the file: the configuration is read-only.
configLocked: Can only be changed on the server
configLockedSecret: Secret: never shown, can only be changed on the server
configHelp_log_level: Lowest level of the messages written in the logs.
configHelp_log_retention_days: Days the log files are kept; older ones are deleted at the end of the bank synchronization (0: kept forever).
configHelp_demo: Demo instance: the login screen shows the public account.
configHelp_savings_category: Category of the savings (and its sub-categories) for the money flow and the trends.
configHelp_public_url: Public address of the server, when the HTTPS proxy does not send it (OAuth, AI agents).
configHelp_currency: Currency of the amounts (ISO 4217 code: EUR, USD, CHF…) in the portal, the notifications and the emails; no amount is converted.
configHelp_update_check: Banner of the administrators when a new release of Carbure is published: the server asks the public API of GitHub for the latest release once a day, sending nothing about the instance.
configHelp_next_month_day: Day of the month from which a received transfer (the salary) counts for the next month: dated on this day or later, it is attached to the 1st of the next month (its real date is kept). 1 to 31, 0 to never move it; 25 by default. Applies to the transactions imported or synchronized afterwards.
configHelp_regex_label: Cleaning of the labels: changing it changes the identifiers of the transactions (duplicates at the next synchronization).
configHelp_jwtsecret: Signature of the sessions: renewed with the security banner.
configHelp_password_salt: Check of the legacy SHA-256 passwords.
configHelp_sync_token: Token of the synchronization scheduler: see the Sync tab.
configHelp_woob_path: woob command run by the server.
configHelp_woob_transactions: Number of transactions asked to the bank per account and per synchronization.
configHelp_woob_logging: Level of the messages of woob.
configHelp_woob_debug: Debug messages of woob in the logs and the synchronization log.
configHelp_woob_auto_update: Automatic update of the bank modules of woob.
configHelp_woob_relabel: Labels fixed by an update of a woob module: the transaction already saved takes the new label instead of being saved a second time. Off by default.
configWarning_woob_relabel: A transaction received with an unknown label replaces the one transaction of the same account, date and amount that the bank no longer sends: new label, category, tags and checking kept. Avoids duplicates after a fix of a module. Risk: two real transactions of the same amount the same day on the same account, only one of which is still sent, would be merged.
configHelp_woob_2fa_wait: Scheduled synchronization: seconds to wait before trying again an account whose bank asks a validation in its app (0 to 300).
configHelp_woob_2fa_retries: Scheduled synchronization: number of new attempts after a validation asked by the bank (0 to 5, 0 to never try again).
configHelp_push_api_key: API key of this instance on the push notification service: masked here, shown under “API key of the instance”; obtained with the “Register the instance” button or pasted here (empty: no push notification is sent).
configHelp_smtp_host: SMTP server of the notifications by email (empty: no email is sent).
configHelp_smtp_port: Port of the server: 587 (STARTTLS), 465 (TLS) or 25 (no encryption).
configHelp_smtp_encryption: Encryption: none, STARTTLS or TLS from the connection (tls); the certificate of the server is verified.
configHelp_smtp_password: Password of the SMTP account: never shown; type a new password to replace it.
configHelp_smtp_from: Sender address of the emails (empty: no email is sent).
smtpTestHelp: Sends an email with the saved configuration, to your address or to the one typed.
smtpTestUnsaved: Save the changes first: the test uses the saved configuration.
pushRegisterHelp: Gets the API key of this instance from the push notification service and saves it in the configuration. With a key already saved, replaces it by a new one (the devices keep receiving the notifications).
pushKeyHelp: Key obtained from the push notification service (https://api.carbure.org). Keep it secret: it allows sending notifications to the devices of this household.
pushRenewConfirm: Replace the API key by a new one? The old one will no longer work.
pushRegistered: Instance registered: key {key} saved in the configuration
pushRenewed: Key renewed: new key {key} saved in the configuration
pushTestHelp: Sends a push notification to your mobile devices with the saved configuration.
pushTestSent_one: Test notification sent to {count} device out of {devices}
pushTestSent_other: Test notification sent to {count} devices out of {devices}
pushUnavailableAdmin: No API key: register the instance to send the push notifications.
pushSettingsMoved: The registration on the push notification service, the API key and the test notification are in the Mobile push tab.
pushStatusTitle: Status of the push notification service
pushStatusHelp: Does the Carbure Push relay answer, and does it accept the API key of this instance?
pushKeyInvalid: Refused by the relay (revoked or unknown): renew it or register the instance again
pushKeyUnknown: The key could not be checked
pushConfigReadOnly: The configuration file cannot be written by the web server: the key cannot be saved.
pushConsentTitle: Consent to the push notification service
pushConsentIntro: To send push notifications to the Carbure mobile apps, this server goes through Carbure Push, the notification relay operated by Carbure, at the following address:
pushConsentSentTitle: What is sent to the relay
pushConsentSentTokens: the tokens of the mobile devices (iOS and Android) that receive the notifications, and their platform;
pushConsentSentContent: the content of each notification: title and text (for example the amounts and labels of transactions, budget alerts) and some data read by the app;
pushConsentSentName: at registration, the name of the instance (the host of its public URL).
pushConsentForwarded: The relay forwards the notifications to Apple (APNs) for iOS devices and to Google (Firebase Cloud Messaging) for Android devices, which deliver them to the devices.
pushConsentStorage: According to its documentation, the relay sees the text of the notifications but does not log it (only the key ID, the number of tokens and the beginning of the tokens are logged), and keeps only the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the device tokens, to bind them to the key of this instance.
pushConsentStop: You can stop at any time: clear the API key (push_api_key) in the settings, and no notification is sent to the relay any more.
pushConsentAccept: I understand and accept that the push notifications of this server go through this relay.
pushConsentOutdated: The relay has changed since: the consent will be asked again at the next registration.
pushInfoError: The configuration of the push notification service cannot be read.
syncCommandHelp: HTTP request to schedule (cron, Synology scheduled task…) to synchronize the bank accounts without opening the portal. It authenticates with the sync_token.
syncTokenMissing: No token is configured: only the synchronization from the portal works. Create one to schedule it.
syncTokenRenewConfirm: Renew the token? The scheduled tasks that use the old one will stop working.
syncCommandNotes: The answer is a stream of events (Server-Sent Events): the progress is shown as it goes, hence the -N option. One synchronization at a time; the Copy button copies the command with the real token.
logsHelp: Entries of the log files of the server (data/logs), newest first. A click on the id of a request shows all its entries.
logsRetention: Log files are kept {days} days, then deleted at the end of the bank synchronization (setting log_retention_days).
logsRetentionForever: Log files are kept forever: set log_retention_days in Settings to delete the old ones at the end of the bank synchronization.
logsTruncated: Large file: only its end (2 MB) is read.
confirmDeleteUser: Are you sure you want to delete user {username}?
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
loginSubtitle: Take back control of your budget
loginDemoWarning: Sample data, reset at each start: do not enter anything real.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired, please log in again.
themeHelp: The high contrast mode of the system is always respected.
deviceNoPush: Notifications unavailable: the app sent no notification token. Log in again in the app after allowing the notifications.
alertThresholdHelp: Any new expense of at least this amount. Empty: disabled.
alertThresholdInvalid: Type a positive amount, or leave empty to disable.
notificationsHelp: Choose how to receive each notification: push on the mobile app (iOS, Android), email to the address of your profile.
notificationsInsightHelp: The amounts are set with the bell of each card of the Insights tab.
budgetThresholdHelp: One alert a month per budget when its spending (sub-categories included) reaches this percentage, from 50 to 200 % (100 % = budget reached).
budgetThresholdInvalid: Type a whole number from 50 to 200.
budgetCategoryThresholdsHelp: The threshold of a category replaces the one of all the budgets for it (e.g. 80% for groceries).
budgetThresholdAdd: Add a threshold for a category
budgetWatchedNone: No budget this month: set some in the Budget tab.
notificationsEmailNoSmtp: Email unavailable: no SMTP server is configured by the administrator.
notificationsEmailNoAddress: Email unavailable: add an email address to your profile.
notificationsPushUnavailable: Push unavailable: the administrator has not configured the push notification service.
noDevices: No registered device (log in from the mobile app)
confirmDeleteDevice: Delete the device "{name}"? It will no longer receive notifications.
webBrowsersHelp: Browsers from which you logged in to the portal. Removing one does not close its session: it shows up again at its next login.
confirmDeleteBrowser: Remove the browser “{name}” from the list? Its session is not closed.
appLinkHelp: Scan this QR code with the camera of the phone: the Carbure app (iOS or Android) opens on this server, its address already filled in. It holds no username nor password.
appLinkQrLabel: QR code that opens the mobile app on this server
appLinkUnreachable: A phone cannot reach this address: set the public address of Carbure (public_url) in the settings.
appStoreHelp: The app is not on your phone yet? It is free, on the App Store and on Google Play.
emptyImportHint: Import a statement downloaded from your bank (OFX, QIF, CSV, CAMT.053), even without a synchronized account.
backupExportHelp: Tick the data to save: a ZIP file is downloaded, with one JSON file per kind of data. Users, passwords, tokens, devices, settings and bank connections are never included.
backupImportHelp: Choose a ZIP exported by Carbure, or one of its JSON files. For a ZIP, tick the files to import.
backupImportWarning: The import deletes then replaces all the data of each kind imported. The other data is kept.
backupImportDrop: Drop a ZIP or JSON file here, or click to choose it
backupFileVersion: File of a later version of Carbure
backupFileEmpty: This file contains no data to import.
backupTooLarge: The file is larger than {size} MB.
backupImportConfirm: The following current data will be deleted and replaced by the backup: {datasets}. This cannot be undone.
purgeHelp: Deletes every row of the chosen data to start again from scratch. Bank accounts, users and settings are kept: a synchronization fetches the transactions again.
purgeWarning: A purge cannot be undone. The data that depends on a chosen one is purged with it. Make a backup first.
purgeNotLocal: The purge is only possible from the local network: open the portal from home.
purgeWithParent: purged with the data that depends on it
purgeConfirm: Every row of this data will be deleted: {datasets}.
purgeConfirmWarning_one: {count} row will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
purgeConfirmWarning_other: {count} rows will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
configHelp_mfa_required: Two-factor authentication at the login of every user (code of an authenticator app: Google Authenticator…). Not asked from a known mobile device, nor in a trusted browser (6 months). Off by default.
mfaRequiredHelp: The administrator requires a code of an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS…) at login, except from a known mobile device or a trusted browser.
mfaOptionalHelp: Protect your account with the code of an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS…), asked at each login, except from a known mobile device or a trusted browser.
mfaEnrollHelp: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
mfaQrLabel: QR code to scan with the authenticator app
mfaSecretLabel: Or type this key in the app:
mfaVerifyHelp: Type the 6-digit code of your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
mfaCodeOrRecovery: Code of the app or recovery code
mfaProfileCodeHelp: New recovery codes need a code of the app; disabling also accepts a recovery code.
mfaInvalidCode: Invalid code: try again with the code shown by your app
mfaExpired: The login has expired: type your password again
mfaRecoveryHelp: Keep these codes in a safe place: each one replaces the code of the app once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
mfaDisableConfirm: Disable the two-factor authentication of your account?
mfaDisableWarning: The app and the recovery codes will no longer work and your trusted browsers are revoked. If the administrator requires it, a new app will be asked at your next login.
mfaBrowsersHelp: Web browsers where the two-factor authentication code is not asked again for 6 months ("Trust this browser"). Revoke the ones you no longer use.
mfaBrowsersHint: Trusted browsers are listed, and can be revoked, in "My devices".
mfaResetConfirm: Reset the two-factor authentication of {username}, for instance after a lost phone?
mfaResetWarning: Their app, recovery codes and trusted browsers are removed. If two-factor authentication is required, they will set up a new app at their next login.

apiErrors.account_locked: Account locked after too many failed logins: ask an administrator to unlock it
apiErrors.account_locked_until: Account locked until {until} after too many failed logins: ask an administrator to unlock it
apiErrors.admin_required: At least one administrator is required
apiErrors.alert_threshold_invalid: The alert threshold must be a positive amount
apiErrors.api_token_lifetime_invalid: The lifetime must be 30, 90 or 365 days, or none
apiErrors.api_token_limit: Too many access tokens: delete the ones you no longer use
apiErrors.api_token_name_length: The name must contain 1 to 50 characters
apiErrors.bank_blocked: The bank blocks woob or the woob module "{module}" is broken, see the known issues of this module on the woob tracker: {cause}
apiErrors.bank_connection_failed: The connection to the bank failed: {cause}
apiErrors.bank_credentials_refused: The bank refused the credentials, check them: {cause}
apiErrors.bank_exists: A bank named {bank} is already configured in woob
apiErrors.bank_name_invalid: Invalid bank name (lowercase letters, digits, - and _)
apiErrors.bank_setting_value_invalid: Invalid value for {setting} (no spaces or quotes)
apiErrors.bank_setup_invalid: Invalid woob module or bank name (lowercase letters, digits, - and _)
apiErrors.budget_alert_category_invalid: The budget watched must be an expense category (or 0 for all the budgets)
apiErrors.budget_alert_category_not_expense: The budget alert threshold of a category needs an expense category
apiErrors.budget_alert_duplicate_category: A category has two budget alert thresholds
apiErrors.budget_alert_threshold_invalid: The budget alert threshold must be a whole number from {min} to {max} (percent)
apiErrors.budget_alert_threshold_limit: At most {max} budget alert thresholds of categories
apiErrors.budget_note_length: The note of a budget has {max} characters at most
apiErrors.budget_note_migration: The note of the budgets needs the pending database migrations
apiErrors.transaction_comment_length: The comment of a transaction has {max} characters at most
apiErrors.transaction_comment_migration: The comment of the transactions needs the pending database migrations
apiErrors.category_cannot_be_subcategory: A category with sub-categories cannot become a sub-category
apiErrors.category_default_readonly: The default category cannot be modified
apiErrors.category_exists: A category with this name already exists
